data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'khulufa' meaning 'to be raised', 'to be high'. This name is used to describe someone who is held in high esteem or someone who has been raised in a noble way. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian.
